title: Talk it through 1.4
role: Events coordinator informing a client about a change of plans
can_do: I can talk about future plans with going to, will and the present continuous.
I can apologize for a change with the present perfect.

nodes.partner_line: Hello. Is the welcome party still on for Saturday?
nodes.translation: Hola. ¿La fiesta de bienvenida sigue en pie para el sábado?

options.text: I'm afraid we have moved it to Sunday.
Yes, it is going to start at seven.
We have changed the time, and I'm sorry about that.

nodes.partner_line: Why have you changed the day?
nodes.model_reply: We have changed it because of the rain.

nodes.partner_line: What is going to happen with the food?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué va a pasar con la comida?

options.text: The caterers are going to prepare it on Sunday.
We will keep the same menu.
We are meeting the caterers tomorrow to confirm it.

nodes.partner_line: Have you told the other guests?
nodes.translation: ¿Les ha avisado a los demás invitados?

options.text: Not yet, but I'm calling them this afternoon.
We have sent a message and we will call again tomorrow.

nodes.partner_line: This is a big inconvenience for us.
nodes.translation: Esto es un gran inconveniente para nosotros.

options.text: I'm terribly sorry for the inconvenience.
I apologize. We will offer you a free drink.
I understand, and I'm very sorry.

nodes.partner_line: Fine. Please confirm the new time by email.
nodes.translation: Bien. Por favor, confirme la nueva hora por correo.

options.text: Of course. You will have it within the hour.
Certainly. Thank you for your understanding.
